newsitem.title: USA: Newpark Resources says approves stock split.
newsitem.headline: Newpark Resources says approves stock split.

text.p: Newpark Resources Inc said on Wednesday that its shareholders had approved a two-for-one split of its common stock, effecting record holders as of May 30.
The additional shares to be issued will be distributed to shareholders on June 20, increasing the total number of outstanding common shares to about 30.5 million, the company said in a statement.
The shareholders also approved an increase in the number of authorized shares to 80 million from the current 20 million, Newpark said.
Newpark Resources Inc provides environmental and oilfield services to the exploration and production industry.
